summary: API V2 — Return filter_1 to filter_5 on sessions/get and sessions/getSession

ai.s: API V2 session read endpoints now return filter_1 to filter_5, so integrators can read back the custom filters they set.
ai.pr: sessions/get and sessions/getSession did not include custom filter values, so values set via sessions/set could not be retrieved.
ai.wy: Complement to EP-57347, requested internally and by DLG.
ai.oc: Both endpoints return five filter fields in the request language, and delta queries pick up filter-only changes; done.

summary: Global Search: make the header search term hand-off to category listings deterministic

ai.s: Makes the header search term hand-off to category listings reliable, so choosing a category opens its listing already filtered by the term.
ai.pr: The search field pushed the route and dispatched the filter together, so the listing's own initialisation often wiped the term, replaced other facets and kept it out of the URL.
ai.wy: Global Search tech debt: the feature only sometimes worked and lost the term on refresh, share and Back.
ai.oc: The term is to travel in the URL and be seeded by the listing, preserving existing facets.

summary: Technical Analysis: Define session image cropping, aspect ratios, and overlay safe zones

ai.s: Documents session image cropping, aspect ratios and overlay safe zones across web and mobile, so organisers can design images that UI badges do not obscure.
ai.pr: Organisers had no specification of session image dimensions or where the Track badge and countdown overlays sit.
ai.wy: Requested for DLG's EuroTier 2026 following EP-57218 and EP-57215.
ai.oc: Developers are to map image containers, crop rules and overlay positions on web and mobile into a client-ready specification.

summary: Widen the SearchField page-id helpers to string and make isKnownSearchPage a type guard

ai.s: Widens the SearchField page-id helpers to plain strings and makes isKnownSearchPage a type guard, matching the untyped template data they receive.
ai.pr: Website Builder templates can hold 23 page ids but the type covered 12, so valid ids could not be expressed and tests relied on double assertions.
ai.wy: TypeScript correctness for Global Search on untyped stored template JSON.
ai.oc: The helper half shipped in EP-57242 across next14 branches; the story is ready for release.

summary: Client Manager: authenticated per-event actuals API for Event Calendar and Planhat reconciliation

ai.s: Adds an authenticated Client Manager API that returns per-event platform actuals to the Event Calendar service and then Planhat.
ai.pr: Client Manager had no external request authentication and no way for other systems to pull per-event actuals.
ai.wy: Operations and Data Ops need actuals for the Event Calendar and Planhat reconciliation.
ai.oc: Unauthenticated or revoked requests are refused and authenticated ones get the specified fields; credential management is an open decision.

summary: [SEO] Participant Profiles: Implement noindex, follow Robots Directive and Self-Referencing Canonical Tags

ai.s: Participant profile pages render noindex, follow and a self-referencing canonical, so attendee profiles stay out of search results.
ai.pr: Around 4,600 public participant profiles were indexable and canonicalised wrongly to the homepage.
ai.wy: Attendee data privacy (GDPR), crawl budget and an SEO audit finding raised for Vinexposium.
ai.oc: SSR metadata for all participant profile routes is to output the robots directive and correct canonical URL.

summary: [SEO] Fix 2-Hop Redirect Chains for /newfront/page/* URLs

ai.s: Redirects legacy /newfront/page/* and /page/* links straight to the clean URL in one hop instead of two.
ai.pr: An SEO audit found 23 redirect chains, e.g. /newfront/page/about → /newfront/about → /about.
ai.wy: Faster loading, less wasted crawl budget and audit compliance.
ai.oc: Both legacy patterns are to redirect directly to /{slug} with a single 301/308.

summary: [SEO] Include Exhibitor, Brand, and Product URLs in XML Sitemaps

ai.s: Adds published exhibitor, brand and product URLs to event XML sitemaps so search engines can discover them.
ai.pr: The sitemap from EP-56823 covered only website pages, news and sessions, missing about 3,300 catalogue pages for large events like Wine Paris.
ai.wy: SEO visibility for participating companies and a technical audit requirement.
ai.oc: Active, published exhibitors, brands and products are to be listed, with drafts and hidden items excluded.

summary: Session Calendar (Mobile): Single-day view with dynamic date selector strip

ai.s: On mobile web the Session Calendar shows a single-day view only, with a date strip listing just the days that have sessions or exhibitor events.
ai.pr: Multi-day views were cramped and unreadable on small screens.
ai.wy: Clearer daily schedule navigation for attendees on mobile.
ai.oc: The multi-day/day switcher is to be removed on mobile and replaced by a dynamic horizontal date selector.

summary: Play & Win without an app update

ai.s: Lets logged-in app users enter Play & Win from the current production app without an iOS or Android update.
ai.pr: A similar authenticated web flow for Lead Capture needed an app update, which Play & Win should avoid.
ai.wy: Launch a marketing promotion remotely without waiting for users to update.
ai.oc: Feasibility with existing auth is to be confirmed first; V1 stores user, event, submitted meeting number and timestamp only.

summary: [Exhibitor] Update AccountsInteractionsReport to expose sync_ts

epic.summary: accountsInteractions: sync_ts cursor field to fix incremental-sync data loss

ai.s: Exposes the new sync_ts value in AccountsInteractionsReport so the accountsInteractions API can page by processing time.
ai.pr: The report layer did not carry ClickHouse's sync_ts, so the incremental sync path could not use it.
ai.wy: Part of fixing incremental-sync data loss on /api/v2/statistics/accountsInteractions, reported by DLG.
ai.oc: The report schema and pipeline include sync_ts with existing time behaviour unchanged; in testing.

summary: [Exhibitor] Update SponsorAccountsInteractionsReport to expose sync_ts

epic.summary: accountsInteractions: sync_ts cursor field to fix incremental-sync data loss

ai.s: Exposes the new sync_ts value in SponsorAccountsInteractionsReport so the sponsorInteractions API can page by processing time.
ai.pr: The sponsor report layer did not carry sync_ts, so incremental sync could not use it.
ai.wy: Part of fixing incremental-sync data loss on /api/v2/statistics/sponsorInteractions, reported by DLG.
ai.oc: The report includes sync_ts with stable pages and unchanged time behaviour; in testing, with a duplicates question open.

summary: not-found pages return HTTP 200 instead of 404 — move Suspense boundaries into pages

ai.s: Makes not-found pages return a real HTTP 404 by moving Suspense boundaries into pages, so the status is set before streaming starts.
ai.pr: Blanket loading files flushed the shell with 200 before pages called notFound(), so every not-found response was a 200.
ai.wy: DevOps asked for real 404s; also affects SEO.
ai.oc: The two blanket loading.tsx files are to give way to page-level Suspense so notFound() can set 404.

summary: Cloning: remap session type "Visible to" / "Available to" ids to the cloned event

ai.s: Cloning an event via "create from parent" now remaps session type "Visible to" and "Available to" category ids to the cloned event's categories.
ai.pr: The legacy copyType() path copied session type audience settings verbatim, pointing at the source event's categories.
ai.wy: Follow-up to EP-56645 for DLG-Feldtage.
ai.oc: copyType() remaps account and exhibitor category ids onto the target event; the main clone path already did; in testing.

summary: Track-Based Session Ordering in Calendar View

ai.s: Orders sessions by track in the Calendar View so each track keeps the same column, with featured and sponsored sessions first.
ai.pr: The cascade placed sessions by start time and duration only, so a track could jump between columns across the day.
ai.wy: Raised by DLG (Dennis Schmitz) so attendees can scan one column per track.
ai.oc: The cascade algorithm is to assign stable track-based column positions with featured and sponsored sessions prioritised.

summary: request sized WebP variants instead of original images across portal-ui

ai.s: Makes portal-ui request sized WebP image variants instead of original uploads, cutting image traffic and CloudFront cost.
ai.pr: 64.6% of image traffic was unsized originals and no WebP was requested, with images at 811 GB a day and about 69 USD of the daily CloudFront bill.
ai.wy: Cost reduction and faster page loads.
ai.oc: The frontend requests sized WebP variants through the existing resize lambda; done.

summary: Catalog all consumers of ClickHouse analytics data (dashboards, reports, exports, APIs, UI)

epic.summary: Analytics Consumer Audit: Resolve Business Logic Discrepancies Across ClickHouse Data Consumers

ai.s: Catalogues every consumer of ClickHouse analytics data across dashboards, reports, exports, APIs and UI, with its data sources and business rules.
ai.pr: There was no inventory of what reads ClickHouse data or which business logic each consumer applies.
ai.wy: First step of the analytics consumer audit to resolve discrepancies between consumers.
ai.oc: A single catalogue lists consumers with owner, data sources and logic notes, reviewed by Bartosz Malec and Kostiantyn Shein; done.

summary: Fix "same meaning, different calculation" discrepancies

epic.summary: Analytics Consumer Audit: Resolve Business Logic Discrepancies Across ClickHouse Data Consumers

ai.s: Aligns analytics consumers where the same metric is calculated differently, so numbers that should match do.
ai.pr: Some metrics with the same meaning were computed differently across consumers, giving mismatched numbers.
ai.wy: First-priority fix group of the analytics consumer audit.
ai.oc: Each bucket-1 discrepancy is to be fixed and validated against the canonical source, with before/after numbers documented.

summary: Present "different meaning, same name" findings to Product for naming/documentation decisions

epic.summary: Analytics Consumer Audit: Resolve Business Logic Discrepancies Across ClickHouse Data Consumers

ai.s: Presents to Product the metrics that share a name but mean different things, so each can be renamed, documented or consolidated.
ai.pr: The same metric name was used for different concepts, confusing customers.
ai.wy: Part of the analytics consumer audit; naming is a product decision.
ai.oc: Findings are to be presented and a decision and owner recorded for every bucket-2 item.

summary: [Stretch] Cross-check ClickHouse statistics against equivalent PostgreSQL data

epic.summary: Analytics Consumer Audit: Resolve Business Logic Discrepancies Across ClickHouse Data Consumers

ai.s: Cross-checks prioritised ClickHouse statistics against the equivalent PostgreSQL data and triages any gaps (stretch goal).
ai.pr: ClickHouse and PostgreSQL values for the same statistic could diverge, as a meetings-count discrepancy already showed.
ai.wy: Stretch goal of the analytics consumer audit to find sync lag, logic divergence or data loss.
ai.oc: CH-vs-PG comparisons are to be documented per metric and gaps routed to the right owner.
